commit.message:
Remove emoji icons and boastful language from examples documentation

Clean up examples documentation to follow documentation standards:

- Remove all emoji icons from README files and HTML content
- Replace boastful language ('demonstrates', 'comprehensive', 'world-class') with neutral technical language ('shows', 'includes', 'provides')
- Remove sales-y language like 'Recommended' labels and checkmark bullets
- Replace star ratings with text complexity levels (Basic, Intermediate, Advanced, Expert)
- Maintain technical accuracy while using neutral, professional tone
- Update HTML titles in configmaps to remove emoji icons

Changes maintain all technical content and functionality while adopting appropriate documentation tone.

Add comprehensive application deployment examples and boilerplate

Create examples/ directory with 4 complete application patterns:

1. simple-app/ - Basic stateless application
   - Nginx deployment with custom configuration
   - ClusterIP service for internal access
   - ConfigMap for content and configuration
   - Security best practices (non-root, read-only filesystem)
   - Health checks and resource limits

2. web-app-with-ingress/ - External web application
   - Helm-based deployment using Bitnami nginx chart
   - HAProxy ingress with TLS termination
   - cert-manager integration for automatic certificates
   - LoadBalancer service via MetalLB
   - Security headers and HTTPS redirect

3. database-app/ - Stateful PostgreSQL application
   - Helm-based PostgreSQL deployment
   - Longhorn persistent storage integration
   - Database initialization scripts
   - ServiceMonitor for Prometheus metrics
   - Backup configuration and security contexts

4. monitoring-app/ - Full observability integration
   - Application with comprehensive monitoring
   - ServiceMonitor for Prometheus scraping
   - PrometheusRule with 6 alert conditions
   - HorizontalPodAutoscaler for auto-scaling
   - Custom metrics endpoints and dashboards

Each example includes:
- Complete Kubernetes manifests
- Detailed README with deployment instructions
- Customization guidelines
- Troubleshooting procedures
- Security best practices
- Integration with homelab infrastructure

Additional documentation:
- examples/README.md - Overview and usage patterns
- examples/DEPLOYMENT_GUIDE.md - Comprehensive deployment guide

All examples demonstrate:
- Flux GitOps integration
- Longhorn storage usage
- MetalLB LoadBalancer services
- HAProxy ingress configuration
- cert-manager TLS automation
- Prometheus monitoring integration
- Security contexts and best practices
- Resource management and scaling

This provides users with production-ready boilerplate for common application deployment patterns in the homelab-foundations environment.
